scripts.prepare: node -e "if(require('fs').existsSync('.git')){try{require('child_process').execFileSync('git',['config','core.hooksPath','.githooks'])}catch{console.warn('Git-Hooks nicht aktiviert: git config core.hooksPath .githooks')}}"
scripts.docker:build:mac: pnpm build && docker compose --env-file .env.docker.mac -f compose.yaml -f compose.mac.yaml build homepage admin backend
scripts.docker:run:mac: docker compose --env-file .env.docker.mac -f compose.yaml -f compose.mac.yaml run --rm --no-deps migrate && docker compose --env-file .env.docker.mac -f compose.yaml -f compose.mac.yaml up -d --wait --no-build homepage admin backend
scripts.docker:build:synology: docker compose --env-file .env.docker.synology -f compose.yaml build homepage admin backend
scripts.docker:push:synology: docker compose --env-file .env.docker.synology -f compose.yaml push homepage admin backend
scripts.docker:build-push:synology: pnpm run docker:build:synology && pnpm run docker:push:synology
scripts.postversion: git push && git push --tag && pnpm docker:build:mac && pnpm docker:run:mac
